install_output_empty: Tihariho ekirugiremu hati. Enyiriri z’okuhendera kuruga omu kikwato ky’okutaho niziija kureebeka aha.
linux_setup_title: Linux erikumurika & SP Flash ekikwato ky'okutebekanisa
linux_setup_welcome: Okutebekanisa ekikwato kya SP Flash ahabwa Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Okutunga n’okutebeekanisa engine erikumurikira aha sipiidi mpango kugira ngu obaasa kugaruraho n’okugaruzaho omuzaani waawe otaine amaani.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek ekikwato ky’okumurikira eky’obuzaarwa n’okuhikaana kw’eibiikiro ry’ebitabo ry’ensi yoona.
linux_card_usb_desc: Nikiha orusa rwa kompyuta kugamba n’omuzaani omu muringo gwa Bootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Ekikwato Enkora y'okukyebera n'okukyebera
system_checker_desc: Okuhamya okuhikire okwa bavugi, ebicweka bya kernel, orusa, n’amabiikiro g’ebitabo g’obwire bw’okukora kureeba ngu hariho okujwara okurikwesigwa.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Nikitebeekanisa kompyuta yaawe kubaasa kukwatiraine n’omuzaani waawe kutunga puroguraamu ezirikugarurwaho.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Nikikyebera okutebeekanisa kwa Linux okw’omurembe ahabwa SP Flash Tool, okutunga USB, orusa rwa serial, n’ebicweka bya system.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Nikitebeekanisa kompyuta yaawe kubaasa kukwatiraine n’omuzaani waawe n’okutaho puroguraamu ezisya omu muringo ogurikwesigwa.
settings_checker_desc: Nikitebeekanisa kompyuta yaawe kubaasa kukwatiraine n’omuzaani waawe n’okutaho puroguraamu ezisya omu muringo ogurikwesigwa.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Kompyuta yaawe eyeteekateekire kukwatiraine n’omuzaani waawe.
linux_prep_ready: Yetebeekaniise, Ekikwato kya SP Flash kitebeekanisiibwe.
linux_prep_blocked: Kompyuta egi terikubaasa kukoresa ekikwato kya SP Flash.
linux_prep_fix_body: Password yaawe neeyetengyesa omurundi gumwe kutebeekanisa kompyuta egi kubaasa kujwara: ebiragiro bya USB eby’ebyoma bya MediaTek n’okutunga serial port.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Okutebekanisa kompyuta egi ahabwa SP Flash Tool, password yaawe neija kwetengyesa omu ntambwe erikukurataho kutebeekanisa ebiragiro bya USB n’okwongyera akawunti yaawe omu guruupu z’abakozesa ba serial ezirikwetengyesa. Waaba oyangire, okushaba nikwija kukingwa.
linux_prep_fixed: Okutunga okuheebwa, SP Flash Tool eyeteekateekire.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Okutebekanisa kwahwa kandi akawunti yaawe eyongyeirwe omu guruupu z’abakozesa ezirikwetengyesa ahabwa SP Flash Tool. Nyabura we, garukamu otandikye kompyuta yaawe kugira ngu orusa orusya rutandikye kukora, reero ogarukye oigure app. Nyiga akabonero k’okukinga app hati.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Kihikire, Kyinga App kugaruka kutandikaho kompyuta
settings_driver_desc: Otakakozeise app egi omurundi gw’okubanza, oine kutaho omuvugi wa MediaTek USB, reero ogarukye otandikireho kompyuta yaawe.
home_desc: Ronda firmware aha Intaneeti nari toorana ekipapura ky’omu kicweka kyawe, reero ogite aha kikwato kyawe.
home_step_2: Toorana puroguraamu kandi ogihe aha Intaneeti
sel_source_desc: Taho puroguramu aha intaneeti, nainga oreete ekipapura ky'omukicweka.
settings_advanced_desc: Yoreka omuringo gw'okutaho, omuringo gw'okutaho n'okushohoza ebicencura.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install: Nyebembere kurabira omu kutaho omu app
settings_guided_install_desc: App neeguma naiwe orikugizibira, okugikwatanisa, n’okugitaho.
settings_sp_gui_install: Teekaho omu SP Flash Ekikwato GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Nikikingaho Updater kandi nikiiguraho SP Flash Tool GUI erimu fairo y’okujanjaaza eya firmware etoorainwe n’ebishushani by’okugabanisa ebiteirweho kare.
settings_terminal_desc: Nikikora okutaho puroguraamu yaawe omu Terminal kugira ngu obone kureeba amakuru g'eby'obuhangwa aha nkurakurana.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Nikikora okutaho puroguraamu yaawe omu Command Prompt kugira ngu obone kureeba amakuru g’eby’obuhangwa aha ntunguuka.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Tikya boona. Ebimwe aha bigyendererwa bya MediaTek nibyanga kujwara okuhitsya obu SP Flash Tool eraheebwa fairo y’okuhamya (.auth); yongyeraho eyaawe aha ekikwato kyaba nikyetengyesa.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Tihariho fairo y'okujanjaaza eyashangirwe omu kibokisi eki, n'ahabw'ekyo tihariho kiragiro kya console ekyabaire nikibaasa kwombekwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Tihariho SP Flash Tool okwombeka nari MTKClient okutaaha omu mwanya oguriho ahabw’omuringo ogu.
terminal_install_failed: Tikirikubaasa kwigura edirisa y'okukoreramu. Ekiragiro ky’okutaho kihandiikirwe ahari {path}.
status_terminal_install: Taho ekiragiro ekikingirwe omu dirisa yaawe ya terminal ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} hati neija kwiguraho okuvuga {method}.

• Ku eraabe etakazimire, zibira {device} yaawe.
• Ku eraabe ekwataniise na USB, banza ogihaho.
{hint}
• Kwatanisa ekikwato kyawe na kompyuta yaawe edirisa ya {terminal_name} yaaba eigukire.

Nyiga OK kutandiika n’okuruga omu Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Ekigyendererwa: Ekikwato kyaba kitarikukwatanisa kyonka, nyiga mpora mpora akapesha aka reset akari omu pinhole n’ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho orupapura obwo orikukwatanisa n’akasimu ka USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Ekigyendererwa: Teeka ekikwato kyawe omu muringo gw’okutunga firmware (nikihinduka kurugiirira aha muringo: nk’eky’okureeberaho, yihaho battery kandi ogite aheeru oine USB cable ekwataniise, nari ozime amashanyarazi oine battery erimu, nari okwate Volume Down/Up obwo orikukwatanisa USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Taho kurabira omu SP Flash Ekikwato GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI hati neija kwiguraho puroguraamu yaawe erimu puroguraamu.

• Omu SP Flash Tool, toorana "Kutunga" kuruga omu kabokisi akarikuza ahansi.
• Nyiga aha rupapura oruriho "Download".
• Reeba ngu {device} yaawe yazima kandi yaarugaho.
{hint}
• Kwatanisa akasimu ka USB ahari kompyuta yaawe bwanyima y’okuteera aha Download.

Nyiga OK kutandikaho Ekikwato kya SP Flash kandi oze omu Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Ku kirikubaasika, emitwe ya Rockbox neehindurwa omu Y1 na Y2 bwanyima y’okutaho Rockbox omu muringo oguhikire.
themes_placement_failed_note: Titwabaasa kuta ekipapura ky'emitwe aha muzaani waawe. Noobaasa kugaruka ogyezeho kuruga omu ntebeekanisa.
settings_rockbox_desc: Nikikoresibwa waaba noocondooza aha bihandiiko bya puroguraamu.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Yoreka Sofutiweya y'onyini eya ira erikurenga 3.0.7.
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Sofutiweya y’okubanza eyashohoziibwe eya ira erikurenga 3.0.7 terikuhikaana na Y1 ezirikuguzibwa na Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Okutaho build eya ira aha units ezi nikiija kuziremesa kutandika kuhitsya obu version ensya eragarukyeho.

Noohamya ngu nooyenda kworeka ebihandiiko bya Original Software ebya ira ebirikukira ahari 3.0.7?
settings_filter_nightly: Yoreka ebyashohozibwa bya Dev buri kiro
settings_240p_tip: Okworeka ebyombeko ebi ROM yaabo eri omu muringo gwa 240p (rom..._240p.zip). 240p ebyombeko tibirikuhikaana n’ebicweka bya Y1 aha Innioasis OS ahansi ya 3.0.7, n’ahabw’ekyo Yoreka ebyombeko bya Rockbox ebya ira nibishoboororwa nabyo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ebihandiiko bya Rockbox-Y1 ebitakahikire 0.5 tibirikuhikaana n’ebicweka bya Y1 ebyaguziibwe bwanyima ya Maaci 2026 na Innioasis OS 3.0.7 ebaire eteirweho.

Okutaho build eya ira aha bikwato ebi nikiija kuzibira okutandika.

Nohamya ngu noyenda kworeka ebyombeko bya Rockbox ebya ira?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Nyabura we toorana .zip, .rar archive, nari fairo y'okujanjaaza (*scatter*.txt) omunda ya folda ya puroguraamu kubaasa kutaho puroguraamu ei waatoorana aha {target} yaawe.
sel_offline: Ebihandiiko ebiri aha Intaneeti tibiriho hati. Koresa fairo y’omu kicweka kyawe, nari reeba oku orikukwatanisa.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Ebipapura bya firmware bingi nari fairo z’okujanjaara bikashangwa omu folda/ekibiikiro eki. Nyabura we toorana folda nari eibiikiro eririmu puroguraamu emwe yonka omurundi gumwe.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Ekihandiiko eki kirimu fairo z’okujanjaaza ezirikurenga ahari emwe, n’ahabw’ekyo Updater terikubaasa kumanya layout ei omuzaani waawe arikwetenga. Omukozi wa {software} akaba naija kwetenga kuhindura aha bihandiiko byabo bya firmware kubaasa kutamu fairo emwe yonka ey’okujanjaaza.
sp_search_restart: Tihariho kikwato hati, okusherura okugaruka (gyezaho {count}). Guma oine omuzaani ataine maani kandi omukwateho waaba nooshabwa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Fayiro y’okuhamya teshangirwe ({path}); okumurikira hatariho n’ekyo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Fayiro y’okujanjaaza terikurangirira omukura gwayo, n’ahabw’ekyo okutebeekanisa kwa konsole ahabwa fairo y’okuhamya tikubaasa kwombekwa; okumurikira hatariho n’ekyo.
sp_config_missing_storage: Fayiro y’okujanjaaza terikurangirira ekika ky’okubiika (EMMC/NAND/UFS), n’ahabw’ekyo okutebeekanisa kwa konsole ahabwa fairo y’okuhamya tikubaasa kwombekwa; okumurikira hatariho n’ekyo.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Tihariho fairo y’okuhamya eyaaheebwa; okumurikira hatariho n’emwe.
sp_config_write_failed: Tibarikubaasa kuhandiika fairo y’okutebeekanisa konsole; okujwara hatariho fairo y’okuhamya.
settings_notifications_desc: Yoreka ebimanyiso bya system ahabw'ekimanyiso n'ebika by'okugaruzaho ahaifo. Off neeguma neebiika buri kimwe omunda ya app.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Ekika n’okugarukamu kw’omuzaani omu hardware. Abazaani b’omuringo gumwe nibabaasa kwombekwa omu kugarukamu okurikukira ahari kumwe — eky’okureeberaho Type A na Type B — kandi software neekorwa ahari emwe aharizo. Reeba ekipande ekiri aha mugongo gw’omuzaani; ku eraabe etarikumanyisa ekika, reka okutoorana kw’okubanza.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Tihariho bihandiiko ebiriho ebya puroguraamu egi hati.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Ebimanyiso bya system tibiriho aha kompyuta egi.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Guma app omu menyu bar bwanyima y’edirisa kukinga, kugira ngu oguma nootunga okumanyisibwa okurikukwata aha kuhindura app na player firmware. Off: okukinga edirisa nikiruga omu app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Reka app omu system tray bwanyima y’okukinga edirisa, kugira ngu okyemereze okutunga okumanyisibwa okurikukwata aha kuhindura app na player firmware. Off: okukinga edirisa nikiruga omu app.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Shereka akatabo k’abantu b’omu kyanga aha Intaneeti kandi oteho puroguraamu kuruga omu fairo z’omu kicweka zonka.
sel_themepack_prompt_title: Oine kutaho ekipapura ky’omutwe gwa Rockbox 360p?
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Oine flash y'okwombeka Rockbox eya 360p. Noyenda kutaho 360p Theme Pack aha kikwato eki hati?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Kwatanisa omuzaani omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Nyabura we, kwatanisa USB, oteho amashanyarazi kandi otandikye omu Rockbox omurundi gumwe (n'ahabw'ekyo neetandika folda yaayo ey'omunda ya .rockbox system), reero ogarukye okore USB kandi otoore 'USB Storage Mode'.

Ku orikuba oine akakwate, nyiga Continue kutoorana folda yoona eri aha player yaawe.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Toorana folda yoona aha kibiiko ky'omuzaani waawe orikukwatanisa
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack etungire gye aha kikwato kyawe!
sel_only_local: Toorana .zip nari .rar firmware y’omu kicweka, nari folda / scatter .txt fairo, ey’okutaho aha Intaneeti, hatariho intaneeti erikwetengyesa. Nikikora na buri kimwe ekirikuteera amakuru ekya Innioasis na Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Toorana ekicweka kya firmware eky’omu kicweka (.zip, .rar) nari folda erimu fairo y’okujanjaaza ey’okutaho aha Intaneeti, neekora n’ebyoma bya MediaTek eby’omutaano.
sel_offline_install: Teekaho puroguraamu kuruga omu fairo ya .zip nari .rar aha kikwato kyona eky’okuhurikiza Innioasis nari Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Teekaho puroguraamu kuruga omu .zip/.rar archive nari omu folda ya puroguraamu aha bikwato bya MediaTek eby’omutaano.
conn_offline: Ori aheeru y'omutimbagano. Ebiteirweho kuruga omu ibiikiro rya Firmware y’abantu tibiriho.
conn_archive_unavailable: Akatabo ka firmware tikarikubaasa kuhikirizibwa kumara akaire kakye. Noobaasa kuguma nootaho kuruga omu ibiikiro nari omu fairo z’omu kicweka.
single_instance_body: Kopi endiijo eigukire, nari ekiriho neekora omu rubaju rw’enyima. Kopi ibiri zikaba niziija kuhakanisa USB y’omuzaani, n’ahabw’ekyo egi terikwija kutandika.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi erikwiruka tegarukiremu okushaba kworeka edirisa yaayo. Nikibaasa kuba kiri busy nari kihanikire. Okugyemeserezibwa kugireka nikiija kuteganisa ekintu kyona eki erikutaho.
single_instance_force_quit: Kugyema kurekyera aho kandi ogarukye otandikireho
single_instance_force_failed: Kopi erikwiruka ekaba etarikubaasa kuhendera. Rekaho iwe wenka, reero ogarukye otandikye okugihindura.
single_instance_busy_body: Kopi erikwiruka n’okutaho puroguraamu nari okugamba n’omuzaani, n’ahabw’ekyo okugihendera hati nikiija kuteganisa ekyo. Okutongoza oku nikwija kukinga; kozesa edirisa eriho nari akabonero kaayo aka menu bar waaheza kutaho.
notices_summary_body: Iguraho Ebihandiiko omu app kubaasa kubishoma.
toast_battery_charged: Otakakozeise eki aha player yaawe, shaagiza battery kumara haakiri eshaaha emwe .
toast_battery_charged_device: Otakakozeise eki aha kikwato kyawe, chaagiza battery haakiri kumara eshaaha emwe .
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Soboorora okumanyisibwa kw’enyima kutunga okutunguuka n’okuha okurabura n’obu Updater yaakuba ekingire aha nkora y’okuhandiikaho.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Soboorora okumanyisibwa kw’enyima kutunga okutunguuka n’okuha okurabura n’obu Updater yaakuba ekingire aha system tray.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Obuheereza bw’okuvunuura aha Intaneeti obwahati tiburikubaasa kuhikirizibwa nari buri aha cooldown. Ebihandiiko by’okubanza eby’okushohoza nibiija kworekwa omu mwanya gwabyo.
translate_unavailable_hint: Okuvunuura tikuriho kumara akaire kakye. Reeba intaneeti yaawe nari ogyezeho bwanyima.
flash_wait_desc: Banza ozime amaani g’ekikwato. Ku kiraabe kikwataniise kwonka kitamanyirwe, gyezaho akasimu ka USB nari port endiijo.
dialog_pre_install_header: Nyabura we reeba ngu {model} yaawe yazimirwa kandi etaine USB .
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Zibira kimwe amashanyarazi g’ekikwato kyawe otakatandikire.
• Ekikwato kyaba kigumire nari kitarikugarukamu, kozesa pini nari ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho orupapura omu kiina ky’okugaruzaho kugyema amashanyarazi kuza omu muringo gw’okutunga.
• Reka akasimu ka USB kataine kakwate obwahati.
• Nyiga Continue, reero okorese ekikwato kyawe kurabira ahari USB waaba nooshabwa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Zibira kimwe ekikwato kyawe kya MediaTek.
• Reka akasimu ka USB kataine kakwate obwahati.
• Okurugiirira aha muringo, gyezaho kukwatiraine n’okutaho battery nari otaine (nari kwata Volume Down / Up obwo orikukwatiraine).
• Nyiga Continue, reero okorese akasimu ka USB waaba nooshabwa.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Titurikubaasa kubiika data yaawe ahabw'okutaho eki ahabw'okuba firmware yaawe eya hati terikuhikaana na Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Taho akasimu ka USB kandi okozese ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho orupapura nari pini kunyiga akapesha k’okugaruzaho, reero ogyezeho kugaruka kukwatiraho.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Nikirungi kukwaata omuzaani aha charger y’aha kisiika kumara edakiika 30 kuhika aha shaaha emwe otakagyezeho kukwaata.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Waaba ori aha Windows, reeba ngu oine .
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • Windows PC ziine kugaruka kutandika bwanyima y’okutaho driver zitakatandikire kukozesebwa.
install_first_which_firmware: Ni software ki erikukora aha {model} yaawe obwahati?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Waaba otarikuhamya, toorana ‘Ebindi’ nari puroguraamu ei orikuteekateeka ngu erimu.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Okugumizamu n'okutaho oku, nyabura we hamya yaaba {model} yaawe yaaheza kukora puroguraamu y'omutaano erikwetengyesa ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Nitubaasa kuguma n’ebintu byawe n’eby’amakuru byawe kyonka omuzaani yaaba yaaheza kukora puroguraamu egi nari puroguraamu erikushushana nayo.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Nitubaasa kuguma nitutebeekanisa ebintu byawe kyonka omuzaani yaaba yaaheza kukora puroguraamu egi nari puroguraamu erikushushana nayo.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Nitubaasa kuguma n’ebintu byawe n’eby’amakuru byawe kyonka omuzaani yaaba yaaheza kukora puroguraamu egi nari puroguraamu erikushushana nayo.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Ikiriza kuguma n'eby'okutebeekanisa n'eby'amakuru aha puroguraamu yoona ey'okutaho
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Okwihaho ekibuuzo ky’okuhikaana. Kozesa eki kyonka waaba noohamya ngu omuzaani naija kuguma naakora n’ebintu ebi arikukora hati n’eby’amakuru.
err_keep_data_failed: Tikirikubaasa kuguma n'ebintu byawe n'eby'amakuru: folda ya firmware terikuhandiikwa. Tihariho ekyateirweho.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Nikiguma nikiteekaho ebitebeekanisiibwe n’eby’amakuru aha player. Sofutiweya esigaireho neeteebwaho nk’oku erikuba eri.
flash_keep_data_warning: Wagumizamu otaine eki, ebitebeekanisiibwe byawe n’eby’amakuru nibiija kugaruka aha nshaho y’omunda y’omuzaani.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Wagumizamu otaine eki, emitwe yaawe ya Rockbox, fonti n’ebintu ebitebeekanisiibwe nibiija kwihwaho. Ebyeshongoro byawe n’ebindi bihandiiko nibiija kuguma aha player.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Wagumizamu otaine eki, emitwe yaawe ya Rockbox, ebigambo n’ebintu ebitebeekanisiibwe nibiija kwihwaho, kandi n’ebibiikwa by’omunda eby’omuzaani nibiija kugarukaho.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Wagumizamu otaine eki, ebitebeekanisiibwe nibiija kugarukaho. Ebyeshongoro byawe n’ebindi bihandiiko nibiija kuguma aha player.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Firmware egi eine kugaruka kuhindura omunda y'omuzaani. Ebitebeekanisiibwe ebibiikire nibiija kusazibwamu; ebyeshongoro byawe n’ebindi bihandiiko nibiija kuguma omu mwanya gwabyo.
format_all_data_warning_other: Firmware egi eine kugaruka kuhindura omunda y'omuzaani. Ebitebeekanisiibwe ebibiikire n’ebintu ebibiikire aha sitooha eyombekirwemu nibiija kusazibwamu. Ebihandiiko ebiri aha microSD yaawe nibiguma omu mwanya gwabyo.
format_all_confirm_body:
Aha {software} twine kugaruka kuhindura omu nkora y'okubiika {model} yaawe omunda tutakagiire omu maisho. Reero okugyezaho okundi okwa SP Flash Tool nikwija kugyezibwa, kwonka omu muringo gwa Format Byona + Okutunga kurabira omu nkora ya XML console-mode.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Taho USB, reero oteho ekikwato ky'okukwatiraho orupapura nari pini omu nshonda y'okugaruzaho pini aha {model} yaawe. Nyiga Next kugaruka kugyezaho omu muringo gwa Format Byona + Download.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool ekagira ngu emeeza y’okugabanisamu omuzaani ekahinduka (8502). Firimu egi eine kuteebwa omu muringo gwa Format All + Download, ogurikugaruka kuhindura ebiri omunda.

support_story_1_lead: Okurinda ekikwato kyawe obutakwatwa emitego ya hardware etarikugamba n’okugarukamu okucwekire.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis buriijo neeshohoza firmwares ensya z’abazaani nka Y1 (ezirikuta omutima aha kuhindura aha board ezisherekirwe nka 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) ezirikuhenda eby’okukoresa ebya ira omu bucureezi. Ekibi munonga, omukutu gwabo niguha okurabura kwa zero n’okutunga zero aha puroguraamu ezaabaire nizikora enyima kugaruka omu mbeera y’amatafaari. Updater na purojekiti ya Community Firmware nibitwara ebicweka: nitubiika buri ROM y’eira, nituhamya okuhindura kwa hardware yaawe, kandi nituguma nituteera gye omuzaani waawe.
support_story_1_item_1: Okucungura Abazaani Abacwekire: Okukyebera eby’okwerinda nikuhamya ngu ebisya tibirikuhenda eby’okukoresa ebya ira.
support_story_1_item_2: ROMs ezibiikire: Okuteerana kw’ebintu byona eby’omu ikorero eby’okubanza Innioasis byasazibwamu.
support_story_1_item_3: Ebikwato by’okukoresa omu nkora: Ebikwato by’okukoresa omu macOS, Linux, na Windows nk’oku biri.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Okumanyisa board omu muringo gw’okwemanyiza kugira ngu buriijo otungye ekipapura ekihikire.
support_story_2_headline: Tihariho Google Drive ezicwekire. Tihariho kuteebereza-okukora. Firmware erikukora yonka.
support_story_2_lead: Eby‘obugaiga by‘ekyanga eby‘omuvuyo gw‘ahaiguru, ebihamibwe ebi orikubaasa kwesiga buzima.
support_story_2_body: Okukuratira puroguraamu ya Innioasis etongore nikikira kumanyisa okucondooza aha mikutu y’empurizana ahabw’enkoragana za Google Drive ezihweireho, okugaaniira kwa Baidu omu bicu okufiire, na fairo za zip ezitarikumanywa ezitaine bikwato ebirikumurinkana. Twombekire omukutu ogurikwesigwa, ogw’okwetongora ogw’okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti n’oburingaaniza bwa SHA-256 obuhamibwe, okumanyisibwa okurikugarurwa busya, n’okutaho ebirikwebemberwa eitembezo aha itembezo. Ebi orikuhayo nibiguma nibibiika butoosha ebi orikutunga n’okubitunga ebirikubaasisa eki kubaho eshaaha 24 buri izooba, ebiro 365 omu mwaka.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti omu bwire bukye kandi hatariho bugarukiro bw’okubitunga nari ebirikukwata aha Intaneeti ebifiire.
support_story_2_item_2: Ebimanyiso by‘okugaruzaho: Yemanyisibwa omu bwire obu ebisya by‘ekyanga birikushohoza nari ebitebeekanisiibwe birikugwa.
support_story_2_item_3: Okutaho Okuhaburwa Eitembezo aha Idaara: Ebirikureebwa gye nibikutwara omu buri kuteera akapesha.
support_story_2_item_4: Ekibiina ky’endimi nyingi: Ekirikugambwa omu bwijwire omu Rungyereza, Oruchaina, Orugirimaani, Orusipeyini, Orufaransa & Orujapani.
support_story_3_headline: Okwiguraho obushoboorozi bwona obw'omuzaani waawe wa Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Okureeta Rockbox, enkora z’okukora ezitari z’amaani, n’obugabe bw’okuhurikiza.
support_story_3_body: Sofutiweya ya Stock factory neesharaho aha mutwe gw’ebi hardware yaawe eya Y1 nari Y2 erikubaasa kukora. Ekicweka kyaitu kikareetera Rockbox, enkora z’okukoresa ezitari z’amaani, okuteera kwa audiophile codec, n’emitwe y’omutaano omu magara. Nitugura empindahinduka z’ebintu by’omubiri kuruga omu nsaho kugyezaho, kugarura enyima, n’okuhamya buri kutaho. Okushagika Updater nikuha sente z’okugyezesa ebi kandi nikutunguura puroguraamu z’okukoresa omu muringo gw’omutaano.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Okuteera amakuru n’emitwe y’abantu erikuteebwaho omu bwire bukye.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware y'ekyanga: Okutunguura battery, UI eshemeire, hamwe n'obushagiki bwa codec y'amakuru ey'omurembe.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Nitugyezaho aha bikwato by’omubiri eby’amazima tutakashohoize ekyombeko kyona.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ya busha, puroguraamu y’okubanza ey’ekihama etaine burango nari okukuratira.
support_story_4_lead: Okurinda puroguramu erikukoresibwa ab'ekyanga okurinda ebyoma byawe kuruga omu myanya y'okusheenya.
support_story_4_body: Kampuni y’ebyoma bya hardware ku erikuza aha kikwato kyabo ekindi, eby’okukoresa ebya ira nibirekyerwaho. Innioasis terikuhereza obushagiki bwa Linux, tihariho changes ezirikureebwa, kandi tihariho muringo gworobi gw’okugarukaho waaba otaireho kuremwa. Updater eriho ahabwokuba abakozesa abaine ekihika tibashemerire kunaga ekikwato ky’okuteera ebyeshongoro ekirungi munonga. 100% y‘ebintu ebirikuheebwayo eby‘ekyanga nibiza butunu omu kuguma n‘ekikwato eki kikingire buri omwe.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Okugaruka omu buteeka okuhamibwe nikugyendera n’obu eby’okukoresa byayanga kutandika.
support_story_4_item_2: Obushagiki bwa Linux obw’omutindo gw’okubanza: Obushagiki bwona MediaTek erikumurikira aha distros za Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Ebihandiiko ebirikushohozibwa omu bwijwire kugira ngu omanye gye empindahinduka.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Empiiha z’abantu: Buri kaawa neetuma eibiikiro rikingire kandi ry’obuntu ahari boona.

retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Nyiga akapesha k’okugaruzaho akasherekirwe n’ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho empapura nari ekikwato ky’okutu.

linux_engine_recheck_desc: Nyiga Re-check nari garuka otandikye okutebeekanisa kubaasa kutunga ekipapura.

linux_perms_ok_msg: Orusa rwa USB & ebiragiro bya udev biteirweho gye. Obuheereza bwatebeekanisibwa.
donate_rely_on_you: Tuyambe aha sente z'okuvuga, oheyo erizooba.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Iguraho ekikwato kya MediaTek SP GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: App egarukiremu kimwe nk'oku yaabaire eri, ekibiikiro ky'okutunga kyashazibwamu, kandi n'ekiijutsyo kya battery kyagarurwamu.
log_app_reset_defaults: Okutebekanisa kwa puroguraamu kugarukiremu kimwe nk'oku kyabaire kiri, okutunga akacupa kakyebeirwe, kandi ekiijutsyo kya battery kyagarurwamu (R).
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Guma oteiremu, Rockbox netandika kandi emitwe yaayo neija kwongyerwaho ahabwayo.
flash_watch_found: Omuzaani yashangwa, yayongyera aha mitwe ya Rockbox...
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Reeba ngu erimu amashanyarazi kandi erimu n’omuriro. Ku kiraabe kyaguma kiri omu mwirima, nyiga pini omu kiina ky’okugaruzaho kandi okwate aha rupapura rwa rwagati (Y1) nari aha rupapura rw’amaani (abazaani abandi) kugaruka kukitandika. Ku kiraabe kitarikwija kutandika, firmware terikutwara, taho endiijo.
action_brom_detected: Ekikwato kyashangwa omu muringo gwa BROM...
action_flash_complete: Flash ehikire! Taho USB kandi ogarukye otandikye.
action_recover_powercycle: Amashanyarazi-hindura omuzaani (kwaata amaani ~10s), reero ogarukye ogikwataniise - ogarukye ogyezeho...
action_wait_mtk: Okutegyereza ekikwato kya MTK... Zima ekikwato kandi okore USB.
action_da_stall: Ekikwato kikarekyera aho kugarukamu obwo barikutebeekanisa omujwekyerwa w'okutunga. Kizime kimwe, ogarukye okikwate, kandi ogarukye ogyezeho.
action_detected_brom: Ekikwato kishangirwe (omuringo gwa BROM) - okutebekanisa omujwekyerwa w'okutunga...
action_detected_preloader: Ekikwato kishangirwe (omu muringo gw'okubanza) - okutebekanisa omujwekyerwa w'okutaho...
action_da_wait_back: Omuzaani akarekyera aho kugarukamu obwo arikutandikaho agenti y’okutunga. Nitutegyereza kugaruka...
action_formatting: Okutebekanisa data y'omukozesa hamwe na cache...
action_restart_brom: Okugaruka kutandikaho omuzaani omu muringo gwa BROM...
log_install_writing: Taho omu nkora - okuhandiika ebishushani bya puroguraamu...
log_sparse_fmt: Ekishushani kya Android ekishangirwe ahabwa {part}, okuhindura omu nkora...
err_code_missing_images: Ebishushani bya puroguraamu bibuzire omu kibokisi
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Okuhamya emeeza y'okugabanisamu kuremirwe bwanyima y'okuhandiika
err_sp_wrong_model: Okakwatanisa model y'omuzaani etahikire. Nyiga aha × kusazamu okutaho oku, reero otoore puroguraamu y’omuzaani ou waakwatanisa.
err_sp_timeout: Ekikwato tikikareebaga omuzaani. Guma oine amashanyarazi kandi otagiihireho, reero okorese akasimu ka USB waaba nooshabwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Omuzaani akatunga amaani kare munonga. Gizimye kimwe, reero ogarukye ogikwate.
err_sp_download_fail: Okuhandiika kukateganisibwa. Reeba USB cable na port hamwe na battery, reero ogarukye ogyezeho.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Omujwekyerwa w'okutunga tarabaasize kutandika. Gyezaho omuringo ogundi ogw’okuteera flash.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Omukozi w’okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti tarabaasize kwoherezibwa omuzaani. Gizime kandi ogarukye ogikwate.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Omuzaani akanga omujwekyerwa w’okutunga (enshobi 6104). Koresa Download Agent erimu SP Flash Tool, kandi oreebe yaaba puroguraamu egi neehikaana n’omuzaani ogu.
err_sp_com_port: Ekikwato ekyo kikaba kitarikubaasa kwiguraho serial port yaakyo. Kinga ebindi bikoreso ebirikumurikira kandi ogarukye obikwataniise.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Omumwanya gwa USB COM gukaba gutarikubaasa kwigurwa (enshobi 1013). Okugaruka kutandikaho kompyuta yaawe nikiija kurekura port ekingire. Nyabura we garukamu otandikye kompyuta yaawe kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
err_sp_enable_dram: Ekikwato ekyo kikaba kitarikubaasa kutandikaho okwijuka kw’omuzaani. Koresa ekipapura ekyombekirwe ahabw’omuringo ogu gwenyini.
err_sp_storage_read: Ekikwato ekyo kikaba kitarikubaasa kushoma ebi omuzaani arikubiika. Reeba oku birikukwatanisa; ekikwato nikibaasa kuba kiine obuzibu omu hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Ekikwato ky‘okumurikira tikirikworeka entunguuka omu bwire bwa sekondi {seconds}, n‘ahabw‘ekyo okugyezaho oku kukakyemerezibwa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Tibarikubaasa kutaho akakwate kahamire n’omuzaani. Reeba ngu ekikwato kyazima (kozesa pini kunyiga akapesha k’okugaruzaho kyaba nikyetengyesa), yihaho USB, kandi ogarukye okikwateho waaba nooshabwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Okumurikira kukateganisibwa nari omurimo gw’okuhandiika gukaremwa. Reeba ngu akasimu ka USB kahamire kandi ngu battery eine charge erikumara, reero ogarukye ogyezeho.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Ekikwato ekirikumurikira kyorekire omurongooti nigwo gumwe kumara sekondi {seconds} ezihwaire kandi tikirikureebeka ngu nikigumizamu kuhandiika puroguraamu ya kompyuta. Flash neebaasa kuba eremirwe. Eki kyaba kiri eky’aha muheru omu kugyezaho kabiri na buri muringo aha nkora erikubaasa kugaruka enyima ahagati yaabo, nari shi MTKClient yonka yaaba eriho aha kyoma eki, garukamu otandikye kompyuta kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient yonka niyo eriho ahabw'okutaho eki. Flash neebaasa kuba eremirwe. Nyabura we garukamu otandikye kompyuta kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Kompyuta egi neebaasa n’okutaho orikukoresa SP Flash Tool. Ku oraabe noobaasa, hindura oze aha SP Flash Tool kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Flash neebaasa kuba eremirwe. Nyabura shoma obutumwa obu aharuguru kandi ogarukye otandikireho kompyuta otakagyezeho. Waaba nooteera OK, app neija kurekyera aho kugira ngu ogarukye otandikire.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Ekicweka kya firmware nikibura fairo y’okujanjaaza nari fairo z’ebishushani ezirikwetengyesa. Nyabura we garuka otungye ekipapura nari otoore fairo ya firmware yoona.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fayiro y'okuhamya ei waatoorana teriho, erimu busha nari terikubaasa kuhandiikwa. Toorana fairo ehikire, nari ogihemu omu Settings, reero ogarukye ogifukye.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ekikwato ekirikumurikira nari abavugi b’emotoka z’emigugu abarikwetengyesa tibarikubaasa kutandika. Nyabura reeba orusa rwa sisitemu, entebekanisa y'omuvugi, nainga ogarukye otemu puroguraamu.
err_driver_missing_title: Omuvugi wa USB ya MediaTek Neyetengyesa
err_driver_missing_desc: Enshobi egi neebaasa kubaho omuvugi wa MediaTek USB yaaba ataine. Nyiga Download Drivers kubaasa kutaho omuvugi wa MediaTek USB, ogarukye otandikye kompyuta yaawe, reero ogyezeho kugaruka.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayiro ya firmware erimu ebiri omu nshaho teriho. Toorana Select Software kugaruka kwombeka fairo eziihirwemu nari kugaruka kutunga ebihandiiko bya firmware. Eki n'ekizibu kya fairo y'omu kicweka, ti nshonga y'okutaho USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Garuka aha Toorana puroguraamu kugaruka kwombeka nari kutunga puroguraamu ya firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Toorana puroguraamu ya firmware ey’okugaruka kutunga.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Enshobi etarikuteekateekwaho ekabaho omu bwire bw’okutaho ({detail}). Zima amaani g’omuzaani goona, ogarukye okwataniise waaba nooshabwa, kandi ogarukye ogyezeho.
flash_method_confirm: Omuringo gw’okutaho guhindukire gwaba {method}. Hamya ngu omuzaani yaaruga omu simu kandi yaazima, reero onyige Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} tibaratungire okutaho okutandika. Bwanyima y’omuzaani kuzima amashanyarazi n’okuruga omu nkora, {other} neija kukoresibwa omu mwanya gwe.
themepack_card_desc: Harimu emitwe mirungi y’abantu, ebishushani by’enyima ebiri aha mutwe, n’ebigambo ebikozirwe ahabw’okworeka 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Eidaara 1: Kwatanisa omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Taho omuzaani waawe orikukwata aha rupapura rwa Power.
2. Rockbox ku eratandikire, ta akasimu ka USB omu kompyuta yaawe.
3. Ku kiraabe nikishabwa aha skriini y’omuzaani, hamya USB Storage mode kugira ngu ekikwato kireebekye nk’omuvugi.
themepack_step2_title: Eidaara 2: Toorana Folder yoona eri aha Player .
themepack_step2_desc: Ahabw’okugira ngu enkora z’okukoresa (nka macOS) nizishereka dotfiles (nka .rockbox) nk’oku ziri, noobaasa kutoorana folda YONA nari omuzi gwa drive aha player yaawe. Nitwija kukusherura nari kukukorera endagiriro ya .rockbox.
themepack_complete: Theme pack ekateebwaho gye! Hati noobaasa kusharaho omuzaani waawe otaine kabi koona kandi otoore omutwe omu Rockbox (Ebitebeekanisiibwe > Ebitebeekanisiibwe Omutwe).
themepack_err_not_found: Tikirikubaasa kutunga nari kutandikaho endagiriro ya .rockbox aha diiraiva etoorainwe. Nyabura we reeba ngu waatoorana folda aha player yaawe.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Eidaara 1: Garuka otandikireho omuzaani kandi ogarukye okore
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Taho akasimu ka USB.
2. Garuka oteho amaani g'omuzaani kandi omurekye atandike kuza omu Rockbox.
3. Rockbox ku eraabe neekora, ogarukye okorese akasimu ka USB, reero onyige Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App egi nereeba ngu ADB ekwatanisa (okuhitsya sekondi 30). Ekikwato kyashangwa, emitwe neehindurwa kandi omuzaani naagaruka atandika. Ekindi, ruga omu maisho oze omu muringo gw’okubiika USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Tihariho kikwato kya ADB ekyashangirwe omu bwire bwa sekondi 30; okugumizamu n’omuringo gw’okubiika USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Tihariho ADB binary eriho aha app; okugumizamu n’omuringo gw’okubiika USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Okuhingisa kwa ADB kuremirwe; okugaruka omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Taho kurabira omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Taho USB Storage Mode aha player kugira ngu ereebekye nk'omuvugi.
2. Toorana folda YOONA aha player eri ahaifo (.rockbox, Ebyeshongoro, Emitwe, nari omuzi gwa drive, folda ya .rockbox esherekirwe neeshangwa yonka).
3. App neekwatanisa emitwe ya 360p n’ebigambo omu, ehandiika aha fairo z’eiziina rimwe.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Hati noobaasa kusharaho omuzaani otaine kabi koona kandi otoore omutwe omu Rockbox (Ebitebeekanisiibwe > Ebitebeekanisiibwe Omutwe).
rockbox_cleanup_step: Okwihaho ebyatebekanisiibwe bya Rockbox ebya ira...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Sofutiweya yaawe ensya ekateebwamu, kwonka folda eya .rockbox eya ira ekaba etarikubaasa kwihwaho. Ihaho folda ya .rockbox aha player n'emikono waaba nooyenda okutandika okushemeire.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Abazaani abarikurenga ahari omwe nibakwatanisa. Ebindi bikyekyeho orekyeho ekirikuteebwaho kyonka.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Omuzaani yashangwa. Okutaho emitwe y'ekyanga hamwe n'ebigambo...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Kwata akapesha ka rwagati kubaasa kutaho Y1 yaawe, ogarukye okore USB, reero otoore USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Kwata akapesha k’amaani kubaasa kutaho amaani omu puroguraamu yaawe, ogarukye okore USB, reero otoore USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Nyabura we, kwataho kandi oteho {model} yaawe, reero onyige Next
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Taho USB, okwate {button} kubaasa kutaho {model} yaawe, reero onyige Next.
rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Kwatanisa {model} yaawe kurabira ahari USB, ogiteho amashanyarazi, reero onyige Next.
rockbox_step_select_rockbox_folder: Nyabura we toorana omuzaani wenka nari .rockbox folda .
rockbox_select_device_prompt: Ni muzaani ki ou orikuteekaho emitwe ya Rockbox?
rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Nyabura we kwatanisa {model} yaawe na USB .
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Nyabura we, taho omuringo gw'okubiika USB aha kikwato kyawe reero onyige Ekindi
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Nyabura we, taho omuringo gw'okubiika USB aha {model} yaawe, reero otoore omuvugi orikureebeka .
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Nyabura we toorana omuzaani wenka nari kimwe aha bihandiiko ebiriho .
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Taho USB kandi oteho amashanyarazi aha Y1 yaawe, reero onyige Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Taho USB kandi oteho amaani aha {model} yaawe, reero onyige Next.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Toorana ‘USB Storage Mode’ aha muzaano gwawe.
2. Nyiga 'Browse Folder...' kutoorana omuzaani waawe kandi oteho emitwe.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Okwombeka kwa Rockbox oku nikukozesa emitwe 240×320, etarikuteebwa omu nshaho. Tunga emitwe ya busha ahabw'omuzaani waawe kuruga aha mukutu gwa Rockbox theme:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: {model} yaawe yaaba etarikutandika, kwata USB, okwate akapesha k'amaani kumara 10s kugaruka kutaho, kandi oteho amaani. Nari kugaruraho puroguraamu y’okubanza.
err_storage_full_desc: Kompyuta yaawe ehweireho omwanya gw'okubiikamu ebintu. Nyabura we, rugaho omwanya aha disiki yaawe ogarukye ogyezeho.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Omuringo gwa Updater ogwa ira gukiine kompyuta egi kandi nigutwara omwanya aha disiki. Okugiihaho nikiihaho omwanya ogwo.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Yihaho puroguraamu ya Innioasis Updater eya ira kandi n'ebitabo ebirikushagika
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Reka ebikwato bya Android (ADB / Fastboot) biteirweho
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Waaba otarikukoresa ADB nari Fastboot aheeru ya Updater, yihaho okugiihaho kandi okagaruka okatunga ebindi ebibiikwa.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Obusinguzi bw'okuboneza okutaho eby'obuhangwa n'okugaruraho omwanya gwa disiki.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Omuringo gwa Updater ogwa ira gukiine aha kompyuta egi. Okugiihaho nikiihaho omwanya aha disiki.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Eki nikiihaho kimwe app eya ira, firmware erikuteebwa aha Intaneeti, na fairo ezisigaireho.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Ihaho ebikwato bya Android (ADB / Fastboot) nabyo? Toorana Keep waaba nookozesa ADB.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Yoreka fairo y'ekihandiiko omu kusherura / okucondooza
log_btn_save_file_tip: Shohoza fairo y'ekihandiiko eyorekirwe aha disiki
settings_arm64_driver_note: ARM64 Obushagiki bwa Windows tiburikugyezibwa. Aha laptop za Snapdragon na RTX Spark, Zadig neebaasa kukoresibwa n’okutaho omukono gw’omuvugi guremirwe kutaho WinUSB nari libusb ahabw’ekikwato kya MT6227 Preloader omu Mutegyeki w’Ekikwato. Reeba obuhabuzi bw‘omuvugi wa ARM64 ahabw‘amatembezo.
donate_family_appeal_expected: Ryan n’omukundwa we nibateekateeka kuzaara omwana. Ebiconco by’okuhwera purojekiti egi n’eka yaitu ensya nibisiimwa munonga.
donate_family_appeal_new_arrival: Hariho omusya orikwija omu muhanda omu nju ya Ryan. Buri kiconco ekirikuheebwayo aha baheereza n’eka yaitu erikweyongyera nikimanyisa bingi.
donate_family_appeal_nursery: Ryan n'omukundwa we bariyo nibeeteekateekyera omwana waabo. Ekikwato eki kyaba kyabaire eky’omugasho, okuhayo sente z’okugikoresa n’eka yaitu erikweyongyera kukaba nikuza kuhwera okukira oku orikumanya.
donate_goal_day_status_fmt: You've helped us raise ${raised} of our ${target} costs today
donate_goal_week_status_fmt: You've helped us raise ${raised} of our ${target} costs this week
donate_support_appeal_archive_forever: Firmware neehwaho abagyenyi baaba bakingire. Ebiconco nibibiika kopi ezacungwire omuzaani waawe aha Intaneeti.
donate_support_appeal_bandwidth: Ekibiina kya firmware nikitwara terabytes buri kwezi. Ebiconco nibishashura bandwidth erikugihitsya.
donate_support_appeal_behind_the_scenes: Tihariho kampuni eri enyima y’eki, omuhangu omwe wenka, entebe y’okukoreraho n’orupapura rw’okuhayo. Buri kimwe nikiza omu sente z’okugyenderamu.
donate_support_appeal_coffee_math: Omwani gumwe niguhika aha bandwidth y’okutunga. Nikigumya okutereeza okurikukurataho omu mwanya.
donate_support_appeal_evenings: Buri kushohora aha nikwombekwa omu mwabazyo na wiikendi. Okuhayo okukye nikugura obwire obwo bwingi.
donate_support_appeal_independent: Tihariho burango, tihariho okukuratira kandi tihariho tier erikushashurwa. Okwetegyeka nikuheebwa sente abantu eki kyahwereire.
donate_support_appeal_kindness: Eki kyaba kyakukoreire, ohereze embabazi. Nikituma purojekiti yaaguma eri ey’obuntu ahari buri omwe orikukurataho.
donate_support_appeal_long_nights: Bugs nizibonezibwa ahabwokuba omuntu akaguma aimukire na model yawe aha bench. Okuhayo nikugumizamu ekyo.
donate_support_appeal_monthly_costs: Ebishare by’okuvuga nibihika ahari doola nka 200 buri kwezi. Eki orikubaasa kwongyeraho kyona nikikingaho ekizibu.
donate_support_appeal_next_feature: Ebikwato, obuhabuzi n’ebiikiro byona n’ebya busha. Tip neeha sente z’ekicweka ekirikurataho.
donate_support_appeal_no_subscription: Tihariho kuhandiikisa, tihariho bwire bw’okuhendera, orupapura nk’oru rwonka. Hayo kyaba kyakuhwereire kyonka.
donate_support_appeal_one_person: Omuntu omwe naagarukamu enshonga, ahandiika obuhabuzi kandi ashashura ebishare. Ebiconco nibireetera ekyo kugumaho.
donate_support_appeal_rescue: Abamwe aha bazaani abu eki kirikushagika bakahandiikwa nk’abacwekire. Okuhayo nikureetera obuheereza bw’okucungura abantu kuguma nibukora.
donate_support_appeal_servers: Servers, okubiika hamwe na domains nibishashurwa kuruga omu nsaho. Omwani niguguma nootunga ebi orikutunga aha Intaneeti ahabwa mukama waabyo orikukurataho.
donate_support_appeal_small_change: Paundi nkye nizikora kihango aha: nizishweka bandwidth y’ebikumi n’ebikumi by’okutaho.
donate_support_appeal_testbench: Ebiconco nibigura ebikwato by’okugyezesa n’ebikwato ebirikukoresibwa kukyebera buri kimwe ekishohoziibwe omuntu weena atakakijwaire.
keep_data_which_firmware_fmt: Ni software ki erikukora aha {model} yaawe obwahati?
settings_run_in_background_desc: Guma app omu menyu bar nari omu system tray bwanyima y’okukinga edirisa, kugira ngu okyeyongyere kutunga amakuru g’okugaruzaho app na player firmware. Off: okukinga edirisa nikiruga omu app.
